keyword.zh: 电动80和HBT8018混凝土泵的区别

title.zh: 电动80和HBT8018混凝土泵有何不同

description.en: Both print 60 m³/h and 40 MPa. Motor, distance layout, aggregate and weight are different cells.
description.zh: 两边都印 60 m³/h 和 40 MPa。电机、距离写法、骨料和重量不是同一格。

h1.zh: 电动80和HBT8018混凝土泵有何不同

directAnswer.en: Electric 80 and HBT8018 are separate concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Both print 60 m³/h and 40 MPa. Electric 80 prints 110 kW, distance 900 m / 300 m and aggregate 24 mm (≤ 2 cm). HBT8018 prints 132 kW, model HBT8018-132S, conveying distance 150 m, delivery height 450 m and aggregate 4 cm and below. Same output does not mean the same reach cell.
directAnswer.zh: 电动80和 HBT8018 是河北品锦机械在邢台的两台混凝土泵。两边都印 60 m³/h 和 40 MPa。电动80印 110 kW、距离 900 m / 300 m、骨料 24 mm（≤ 2 cm）。HBT8018 印 132 kW、型号 HBT8018-132S、输送距离 150 m、输送高度 450 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下。产量相同不等于距离格相同。

heading.en: Where Electric 80 and HBT8018 print different values

body.en: Model line: Electric 80 prints Electric 80 / HBT80-1816-110; HBT8018 prints HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S. Motor power: Electric 80 prints 110 kW; HBT8018 prints 132 kW. Max. aggregate size: Electric 80 prints 24 mm (≤ 2 cm); HBT8018 prints 4 cm and below. Dimensions: Electric 80 prints 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm; HBT8018 prints 6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm. The same printed value on a shared label: Theoretical output is 60 m³/h on both pages. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 型号行：电动80印 Electric 80 / HBT80-1816-110；HBT8018印 HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S。电机功率：电动80印 110 kW；HBT8018印 132 kW。最大骨料粒径：电动80印 24 mm (≤ 2 cm)；HBT8018印 4 cm and below。外形尺寸：电动80印 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm；HBT8018印 6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm。同一标题下数值相同的有：理论输送量两边都是 60 m³/h。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: Electric 80 prints cells that HBT8018 does not: Max. outlet pressure 40 MPa; Hopper capacity 0.7 m³; Pumping distance (H / V) 900 m / 300 m; Hydraulic pump Kawasaki 140 double pump; Main unit weight 6000 kg. HBT8018 prints cells that Electric 80 does not: Pumping pressure 40 MPa; Conveying distance 150 m; Delivery height 450 m; Delivery pipe diameter 100 / 125 mm; Total weight 6500 kg. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: 电动80有、HBT8018没有的行：最大出口压力 40 MPa；料斗容积 0.7 m³；输送距离（水平/垂直） 900 m / 300 m；液压泵 Kawasaki 140 double pump；整机重量 6000 kg。HBT8018有、电动80没有的行：泵送压力 40 MPa；输送距离 150 m；输送高度 450 m；输送管内径 100 / 125 mm；整机重量 6500 kg。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: HBT8018 writes distance and height as two labels. Electric 80 writes one H / V pair. Open /en/products/electric-80-concrete-pump/ for Electric 80 and /en/products/hbt8018-concrete-pump/ for HBT8018. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: HBT8018 把距离和高度分成两个标题。电动80写成一组水平/垂直。看电动80请打开 /zh/products/electric-80-concrete-pump/，看HBT8018请打开 /zh/products/hbt8018-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Electric 80 print the same model line as HBT8018?
question.zh: 电动80和HBT8018的型号行一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 80 prints Electric 80 / HBT80-1816-110. HBT8018 prints HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动80印 Electric 80 / HBT80-1816-110。HBT8018印 HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 80 print the same motor power as HBT8018?
question.zh: 电动80和HBT8018的电机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 80 prints 110 kW. HBT8018 prints 132 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动80印 110 kW。HBT8018印 132 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 80 print the same max. aggregate size as HBT8018?
question.zh: 电动80和HBT8018的最大骨料粒径一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 80 prints 24 mm (≤ 2 cm). HBT8018 prints 4 cm and below. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动80印 24 mm (≤ 2 cm)。HBT8018印 4 cm and below。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is max. outlet pressure missing on HBT8018?
question.zh: 为什么HBT8018没有最大出口压力？

answer.en: The HBT8018 page does not print that label. Electric 80 prints 40 MPa. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: HBT8018这一页没有印这个标题。电动80印的是 40 MPa。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
